newsitem.title: USA: Revlon holding co to defease zeros due 1998.
newsitem.headline: Revlon holding co to defease zeros due 1998.

text.p: Revlon Worldwide Corp announced on Friday that it plans to defease $1.15 billion in senior secured discount notes due 1998 which are collateralized by 83.1 percent of Revlon Inc stock.
Revlon Worldwide said it will obtain the necessary funds to defease the debt by issuing a new series of zero coupon bonds and through a capital infusion by MacAndrews & Forbes Holdings Inc.
The company said no sale of Revlon Inc stock is contemplated.
Revlon Worldwide is a holding company whose only significant assets are the 83.1 percent of the shares of Revlon Inc stock.
The Revlon shares are owned by MacAndrews & Forbes, a company which is 100 percent owned by Ronald Perelman. The 83.1 percent stake represents 97.4 percent of the voting power of Revlon Inc.
A spokesman for MacAndrews & Forbes declined to comment about the size or the timing of the new zero coupon bond offering.
